title: GMUT EFT renormalization-group, operator-mixing, and matching-scale tribunal
hypothesis: A formal tribunal can reject a GMUT EFT comparison unless the operator basis, coefficient dimensions, anomalous-dimension mixing, scheme, matching scale, truncation order, boundary data, and claimed scale invariance are explicit and consistent.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate coefficient units, operator identifiers, basis map, anomalous-dimension entries, scale direction, scheme, matching threshold, truncation order, and claim class; dimensionally inconsistent, incomplete, scale-dependent, or promoted rows must fail.
evidence_class: bounded structural or proxy software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the declared synthetic tribunal and does not promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
